unlisted_practices: Prompt engineering and offline knowledge distillation to build an LLM conversational patient-reported outcome collection system
Comparing LLM chatbot ePRO with form-based and rule-based chatbot ePRO on patient response rate and interaction time

screen.reason: The study develops and pilots an LLM-based electronic patient-reported outcome (ePRO) chatbot deployed to real patients via WeChat Mini Program, comparing its engagement to rule-based and standard form methods without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment guardrail.
